posts.author: Himalaya734
posts.text: 28. sep. Peru Ridge proposes 136 gas engines and trucked CNG The Peru Ridge application describes a 218 MW-capable system using 136 Jenbacher J420 engines. Its main application narrative lists six Tier 4 diesel black-start generator sets, six 1,240-gallon diesel tanks, 72 medium-voltage transformers, 136 selective catalytic reduction systems and 176 mobile CNG tanks. Aggreko would operate and maintain the temporary system, and Certarus would handle CNG delivery and mobile storage. 176 mobile tanks on site, da snakker man volum. https://w4news.org/storey-tric-temporary-gas-generation-orders/
